name: metabob
description: Metabob MCP: a shared work ledger, code-structure tools and the substrate cockpit for AI agents

api_key.title: Metabob API key
api_key.description: Your substrate API key. Leave blank to use the one the substrate installer wrote (~/.substrate/config.json).

discovery_endpoint.title: Discovery endpoint
discovery_endpoint.description: The substrate's discovery address, for a remote substrate (e.g. https://discovery.example.com). Leave blank to use the installer's config.

endpoint.title: Substrate endpoint
endpoint.description: A local substrate's endpoint (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:18080), from which discovery is derived. Leave blank otherwise.
